title: Plan & scaffold: cargo init, module tree, constants, core types, error type
description:
Bootstrap the Rust project at ~/nhs/soft/astrology/swisseph.rs/.

## What to build

1. **cargo init** — lib crate, edition 2021+
2. **Module tree** — one module per domain, mirroring the C file structure:
   ```
   src/
     lib.rs
     types.rs        — Body, HouseSystem, CalendarType, SiderealMode enums
     flags.rs        — SEFLG_* as bitflags crate bitfield
     constants.rs    — physical constants (AUNIT, CLIGHT, HELGRAVCONST, etc.), SE_* IDs
     error.rs        — SwissEphError enum replacing C's serr buffer + return codes
     context.rs      — pub struct Ephemeris { config, cache, files } skeleton
     date.rs         — Phase 1: swedate.c
     math.rs         — Phase 2: coordinate transforms, angle normalization, Chebyshev
     precession.rs   — Phase 3: precession, nutation, obliquity, delta-T, sidereal time
     moshier/        — Phase 4: mod.rs, planets.rs, moon.rs, tables.rs
     calc.rs         — Phase 5: core dispatcher, apparent position pipeline
     sweph_file.rs   — Phase 6: .se1 file reader
     jpl.rs          — Phase 7: JPL DE reader
     ayanamsa.rs     — Phase 8
     stars.rs        — Phase 9
     houses.rs       — Phase 10
     eclipse.rs      — Phase 11: eclipses, rise/set, occultations, refraction
     phenomena.rs    — Phase 12: phase angle, nodes, orbits, crossings, Gauquelin
     heliacal.rs     — Phase 13
   ```
3. **Constants** — translate from swephexp.h and sweodef.h:
   - Body IDs: SE_SUN=0 through SE_PLUTO=9, SE_MEAN_NODE=10, etc. → `Body` enum
   - SEFLG_* flags → `bitflags!` macro (JPLEPH=1, SWIEPH=2, MOSEPH=4, SPEED=256, HELCTR=8, etc.)
   - House system chars (P, K, O, R, C, etc.) → `HouseSystem` enum
   - Calendar: SE_GREG_CAL=1, SE_JUL_CAL=0 → `CalendarType` enum
   - Sidereal modes: SE_SIDM_FAGAN_BRADLEY=0 through SE_SIDM_LAHIRI_ICRC=46 → `SiderealMode` enum
   - Physical constants: AUNIT=1.49597870700e11, CLIGHT=2.99792458e8, etc. → `pub const`
   - Precession/nutation/delta-T model IDs → enums
4. **Context struct skeleton**:
   ```rust
   pub struct Ephemeris {
       config: EphemerisConfig,      // paths, topo position, sidereal mode, model selections
       cache: CalculationCache,      // planet data, obliquity, nutation, position cache
       files: FileManager,           // open ephemeris files, star catalog
   }
   ```
   Empty impls for now — just the struct definitions and `Ephemeris::new()`.
5. **Error type**:
   ```rust
   pub enum Error {
       InvalidBody(i32),
       InvalidDate { year: i32, month: i32, day: i32 },
       EphemerisNotAvailable { body: Body, source: EphemerisSource },
       BeyondEphemerisLimits { tjd: f64, range: (f64, f64) },
       FileNotFound(PathBuf),
       FileFormat(String),
       CircumpolarBody,
       // ...
   }
   ```

## C references
- swephexp.h:1-1020 — all public constants, body IDs, flag definitions
- sweodef.h:1-326 — platform defines, type aliases (int32, centisec, TLS, etc.)
- sweph.h:1-849 — internal structs (swe_data, plan_data, node_data, etc.)

## Dependencies
None — this is the foundation.

decisions.rationale: C's serr buffer primarily reports ephemeris fallback, which is already encoded in the return flags. CalcResult.flags_used covers 95% of the warning surface. Starting lean avoids designing a Warning taxonomy before knowing what warnings matter. Can add warnings field later if needed.
decisions.rejected: Embedded Vec<Warning> in CalcResult — premature taxonomy; custom Outcome<T> enum — non-standard, extra ceremony for callers
decisions.title: Warning handling: flags_used, no Warning type

decisions.rationale: 23 named bodies (0-22) cover the common case with good ergonomics (Body::Mars not Body::Planet(Planet::Mars)). Open ranges (asteroids, comets, planet moons) can't be enumerated — parameterized variants (Asteroid(i32), etc.) handle them. Fictitious(i32) for 40-999 range with FictitiousBody companion enum for the named 40-58 subset.
decisions.rejected: Nested sub-enums (Body::Planet(Planet::Mars)) — verbose for callers, extra unwrapping everywhere; flat enum with all fictitious named — clutters match arms for rarely-used bodies
decisions.title: Body enum: named variants + parameterized open ranges

decisions.rationale: Config struct is transparent, serializable, sufficient for scaffold. Builder pattern adds ceremony before we know the full config surface. Can add builder as sugar later.
decisions.rejected: Builder pattern — premature before full config surface is known; direct args — doesn't scale as config grows
decisions.title: Construction: EphemerisConfig struct with Default, no builder

decisions.rationale: From phase-1-considerations.md. All methods take &self, making Ephemeris Send + Sync without locking. Pure function pipeline: inputs → math → output. Modern CPUs make recomputation cheap; callers can layer caching externally if needed.
decisions.rejected: Mutable cache inside Ephemeris (C's approach) — requires &mut self, prevents concurrent access, recreates C's thread-safety problems
decisions.title: Stateless architecture: Ephemeris is immutable, no cache

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review (adversarial, 2026-06-24):

Verdict: needs-attention

Finding [medium]: Parameterized Body variants bypass safe C ID conversion ranges (src/types.rs:34-70). TryFrom<i32> correctly gates the C ID spaces, but public tuple variants + unchecked to_raw_id() let callers construct values that skip those checks. Body::Asteroid(-10000).to_raw_id() aliases SE_SUN (0), Body::PlanetMoon(1000) aliases asteroid 0, Body::Fictitious(23) emits an invalid gap ID.

Recommendation: Replace raw i32 payloads with constrained newtypes or checked constructors, validate in to_raw_id() / return Result.
